📄 Iran’s nuclear chief congratulates new defense minister, stresses strategic technology development

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Mohammad Eslami, vice president and head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran, congratulated Mehrdad Akhlaghi Ketabchi on his appointment as defense minister and the confidence vote he received from parliament.

In a message issued on Monday, Eslami highlighted Akhlaghi’s experience in the defense and aerospace industries, research, engineering, and the development of strategic military infrastructure.
​
He said the new minister’s professional record reflected specialized expertise, managerial foresight and a commitment to national self-sufficiency.
​
Eslami also emphasized the importance of expanding domestic production capacity, ensuring a steady supply of military equipment and strengthening Iran’s defense capabilities and deterrence.
​
He expressed hope that Akhlaghi would draw on his experience to rebuild and establish production infrastructure, advance strategic technologies and develop human resources, helping reinforce Iran’s defense foundations, national independence and strength.
